description: This Perl script extracts and processes build-related information about targets, architectures, kernels, and devices for a software project, likely within a build or configuration system. It executes make commands in specific directories, parses their output, and stores structured data about build targets and device profiles.

methods.name: parse_targetinfo
methods.description: Parses target information by executing make commands and extracting target name, architecture, kernel versions, and features from their output.

methods.name: parse_devices
methods.description: Parses device profile information from make command outputs, handling primary and alternative device names.

methods.name: get_targetinfo
methods.description: Iterates over target directories, invokes parsing functions for each target and subtarget, and collects data.

methods.name: get_devices
methods.description: Sets up device parsing for a specified target/subtarget based on directory structure and invokes the parse_devices method.
